kind: fixed recurrence teaching inputs, no model checkpoint
layout: S has key rows and value columns, shape 2x3; o = transpose(S) q
gradientScope: Initial state, value vectors, channel-decay scalars and write-strength scalars only, 30 local inputs. Keys and queries are fixed unit vectors; upstream projections, gate parameterization and key/query normalization derivatives are excluded.

memoryLedger.unit: scalar slots, all the same precision
memoryLedger.excludes: Short-convolution state, projections, weights, activations, allocator alignment and real model head/dimension differences.

overwriteBoundary.scope: Exact beta=1 endpoint of the teaching recurrence; not a claim that a finite sigmoid logit attains beta=1.
